title: Sick
description: A maximalist collage piece leaning into Y2K/manga scrapbook energy — a chaotic, all-seeing-eye silhouette built from repeating iconography, framed by barbed neon-green rings and scattered stars that read as digital thorns. The bold Japanese display type at the base grounds an otherwise noisy composition, while the small mascot figure tucked in the corner adds a note of dark humor against the aggression of the title.
